newsitem.title: USA: KU Energy, Conoco in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: KU Energy, Conoco in joint venture.

text.p: KU Energy Corp and Conoco said Thursday they have formed a strategic gas marketing joint venture between their respective subsidiaries, KU Solutions and Alliance Energy Services.

KU said the joint venture will enable the companies to capitalize on their combined marketing expertise in electricity and natural gas by offering both sources of energy, enabling it to satisfy customers' increasing demand for a single source to meet all energy needs.
AES is 50-percent owned by Conoco, the energy subsidiary of DuPont Co, and is the company's Central and Eastern United States natural gas end-user marketing arm.
KU Solutions is a subsidiary of KU Energy Corp.
